subject: removing figure caption in knit to HTML?

messages.author: d567d0ef3c054a35
messages.subject: removing figure caption in knit to HTML?
parts:
Greetings. I have an Rmd document for which I need to have a *numbered* table
of contents. I've been using RStudio to knit the Rmd file to HTML and then
using pandoc to generate a modified version of the HTML code, i.e., containing
the numbered TOC.

pandoc -s -S --mathjax --toc --number-sections foo.md -o foo_toc.html

I've appended a simple example. The "regular" HTML, foo.html, from knitr
looks fine, but the HTML file produced by pandoc contains the text:

plot of chunk someChunkLabel

below and to the left of the histogram.

If I edit foo.md (the one produced by knitr) such that the line:

![plot of chunk someChunkLabel](figure/someChunkLabel.png)

becomes:

![ ](figure/someChunkLabel.png)

before running foo.md file through pandoc, then the gratuitous text
disappears. (No surprise)

Is there some way I can tell knitr to do this by default? And/or is there a
better overall approach to the problem?

Thanks,

-- Mike


$ cat foo.Rmd
# a test: does the Rmd chunk label appear with the plot?

```{r someChunkLabel}

zzz <- rnorm(100)
hist(zzz)

```

$ cat foo.md
# a test: does the Rmd chunk label appear with the plot?


```r

zzz <- rnorm(100)
hist(zzz)
```

![plot of chunk someChunkLabel](figure/someChunkLabel.png)

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] removing figure caption in knit to HTML?
parts:
That is the figure caption controlled by the fig.cap option. You can
use fig.cap='' or set it globally opts_chunk$set(fig.cap='')

Regards,
Yihui
